title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (3,000 affected)
summary: THE FUEL TANKS ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY EXHIBIT FUEL LEAKAGE WHEN COMPLETELY FILLED. THIS CONDITION WAS CAUSED BY THE REAR FLOOR CARPET FASTENERS PENETRATING THE TOP OF THE FUEL TANK.

title: Redundant JAGUAR ROVER TRIUMPH INC.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL:PEDAL (1,400 affected)
summary: A DEFECTIVE WELD  CONDITION MAY EXIST AT THE PEDAL TO ACCELERATOR ROD CONNECTION.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:LINKAGES:ARM:PITMAN (100 affected)
summary: THE STEERING PITMAN ARM IS SUBJECT TO FAILURE AT THE AREA OF THE TRANSITION TO THE ARM OFFSET DUE TO HIGH STRESS CONCENTRATIONS.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (268 affected)
summary: THE AIR RESERVOIR ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE A DESIGN DEFICIENCY. THE RESERVOIR MAY NOT BE STRONG ENOUGH TO WITHSTAND PRESSURES GENERATED DURING OPERATION.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (400 affected)
summary: A DESIGN DEFICIENCY EXISTS IN THE AIR DRYER PIPING IN THE AREA OF THE PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE AND COMPRESSOR GOVERNOR CONTROL LINK. MOISTURE IS PASSED AND BUILDS UP IN THIS RELIEF VALVE AND CONTROL LINE. IN FREEZING AMBIENT TEMPERATURES, THIS MOISTURE MAY FREEZE, ALLOWING THE CHASSIS AIR SYSTEM PRESSURE TO EXCEED 150 PSI. EXCESSIVE AIR SYSTEM PRESSURE CAN CAUSE SEPARATION OF AIR PIPING CONNECTIONS AND AIR SYSTEM VALVE FAILURE.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: SUSPENSION:TANDEM AXLE:REAR:V-BOLT AND ATTACHMENTS (33,000 affected)
summary: THE TEE BRACKET, WHICH IS MOUNTED ON THE FRONT AXLE OF THE BOGIE, MAY FAIL DUE TO VIBRATION BROUGHT ON BY ROAD SURFACE IRREGULARITIES. BRACKET FAILURE WOULD LEAVE THE TEE BRACKET UNSUPPORTED AND CAUSE BROKEN HOSE CONNECTOR FITTINGS. THIS WOULD RESULT IN AUTOMATIC APPLICATION OF THE SPRING EMERGENCY BRAKES.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: ENGINE (459 affected)
summary: THE SYNFLEX-TYPE OIL PRESSURE SIGNAL LINE MAY HAVE BEEN ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD. EXCESSIVE HEAT MAY CAUSE THE LINE TO RUPTURE, AND OIL LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:DISC BRAKES (118,544 affected)
summary: DURING VEHICLE OPERATION IN HEAVY RAIN, THERE MAY BE A NOTICEABLE INITIAL REDUCTION IN THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE REAR DISC BRAKE, FOLLOWED BY A GRADUAL RECOVERY TO NORMAL, DRY CONDITION EFFECTIVENESS. IF PEDAL FORCE IS NOT INCREASED TO COMPENSATE, LONGER STOPPING DISTANCES WILL RESULT. IF PEDAL FORCE IS NOT REDUCED AFTER RECOVERY, A REAR WHEEL SKID COULD RESULT.

title: LANDAU MOTOR HOME: LIGHTING:GENERAL OR UNKNOWN COMPONENT:HEAD LIGHTS (80 affected)
summary: THE WIRES LEADING FROM THE HEADLIGHTS TO THE POWER SOURCE, DUE TO THEIR LENGTH, MAY CAUSE A REDUCTION IN HEADLIGHT ILLUMINATION. ALSO, THE HEADLIGHT SCREW MOUNTINGS INHIBIT PROPER DIRECTIONAL ADJUSTMENT CAPABILITIES.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:LINER (3,018 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". THE TIRES HAVE A DEFECTIVE INNER LINER CONDITION WHICH MAY PROMOTE PLY OR TREAD SEPARATION WHICH COULD LEAD TO TIRE AIR LOSS.

title: Ford Motor Company: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:LEVER AND LINKA (47,339 affected)
summary: THE SHIFT SELECTOR REACTION SPRINGS MAY BE DEFORMED AS A RESULT OF IMPROPER INSTALLATION OF SELECTOR LEVERS DURING COLUMN BUILDUP. THUS THE LEVER MAY NOT BE ABLE TO BE MOVED INTO THE INSERT DETENTS LOCATED IN THE STEERING COLUMN ASSEMBLY. THIS COULD PREVENT THE "PARK" GEAR FROM BEING ENGAGED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (20,000 affected)
Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:UNKNOWN TYPE (35,553 affected)
summary: THE SHIFT CAM STOPPER BOLT LOCK TAB ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY NOT PREVENT THE STOPPER BOLT FROM LOOSENING. THIS COULD ALLOW THE SHIFT DRUM TO MOVE LATERALLY.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): STEERING:COLUMN COUPLING (9,000 affected)
summary: AN INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT CONTAINING A MISMATCHED POT COUPLING ASSEMBLY MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED ON THE INVOLVED VEHICLES. THIS COUPLING MAY HAVE AN OVERSIZED SERRATION DIAMETER. AN OVERSIZED SERRATION COULD PREVENT THE COUPLING FROM ADEQUATELY TIGHTENING ONTO THE GEAR OR SHAFT SPLINES.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:STANDARD:MANUAL 3 SPEED (96,933 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN BUILT WITH THE TRANSMISSION ADAPTER PLATE SEAL IMPROPERLY SEATED. THIS CONDITION COULD ALLOW A GRADUAL TRANSFER OF LUBRICANT FROM THE TRANSMISSION TO THE TRANSFER CASE.

title: FIRESTONE TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES (450 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES MAY CONTAIN A PIN HOLE IN THE UPPER SIDEWALL AREA OF THE TIRE. THIS CONDITION MAY CAUSE A FLEX CRACK TO APPEAR IN THE GENERAL AREA OF THE HOLE DURING TIRE USAGE. UNDER CONTINUED USE, THE CRACK MAY PROGRESS AND CAUSE LOSS OF AIR.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (3,350 affected)
summary: THERE IS A POSSIBILITY THAT THE BATTERY SET PLATE (MOUNTING BRACKET) MAY PHYSICALLY CONTACT THE REAR BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER REMOTE RESERVOIR HOSE. PROLONGED USAGE COULD RESULT IN HOSE WEAR AND BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE.

title: TRANSAMERICAN ROOSEVELT: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY (1,083 affected)
summary: THE FRONT FENDER BRACKET MAY BREAK IN SOME INSTANCES AS A RESULT OF METAL FATIGUE, BROUGHT ON BY NORMAL OPERATIONAL VIBRATIONS.

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES:BEAD (770 affected)
summary: THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT TIRE BREAKER EDGE LOOSENESS MAY OCCUR AND LEAD TO TREAD CHUNKING OR LOCAL TREAD SEPARATION.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:TREAD (3,725 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". TIRES MAY FAIL IN SERVICE AS A RESULT OF TREAD SEPARATION AND PARTIAL TREAD LOSS.

title: UNIROYAL GOODRICH TIRE CO: TIRES:BEAD (1,452 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED TIRES FAIL TO MEET THE ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO.109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES". THE TIRES MAY FAIL IN SERVICE DUE TO SEPARATION IN THE BEAD AREA ADJACENT TO THE RIM.
